rootCause: The public /api/connectors/readiness endpoint unnecessarily bootstrapped the full connector execution runtime just to expose capability state. That widened the module-load/runtime failure surface. The earlier process.env hardening was real but insufficient and therefore was not the final root cause.
failedApproach: Treating process.env access as the complete root cause after the endpoint remained broken in an exact-SHA production deploy.
Considering deployment/routing drift as the remaining cause after the connector-readiness function was proven present in the exact production deploy.
fix: Extract readiness-state computation into a shared pure helper.
Keep the full connector runtime reusing the helper instead of duplicating readiness logic.
Make the public readiness function depend only on the readiness helper, not the full connector execution engine.
Read runtime environment through globalThis.Netlify?.env?.get?.(key) and degrade safely to the existing sample-only/not-configured readiness states when that platform global is absent.

rules: Health/readiness endpoints must import only the minimum modules required to report capability state and must not bootstrap execution engines, provider adapters, stores or side-effectful runtime paths unless the endpoint actually needs them.

Platform runtime globals must be accessed through the platform authority with a test/runtime-safe guard; absence of the platform global must degrade to an explicit non-configured state instead of crashing.
A partial fix that changes the symptom without green live readback must remain an open recovery obligation; do not promote the first plausible hypothesis to canonical root cause.
Exact production deployment is necessary but not sufficient: route-level live JSON readback is required before LIVE_VERIFIED.
Reuse one shared readiness computation to prevent drift between the public readiness endpoint and the full connector runtime.

regressionTest: connector readiness uses guarded Netlify runtime env authority
connector readiness does not import connector-runtime.mjs
connector readiness preserves /api/connectors/readiness and application/json contract
full connector runtime reuses the same readiness-state helper

evidence.live_contract: /api/connectors/readiness returned valid readiness JSON after exact-SHA production deployment

outcome: The connector readiness route recovered in production and the incident changed the canonical learning: minimize readiness dependency surfaces, distinguish plausible hypotheses from proven root causes, and require exact live route evidence before closure.
reuse_instruction: Future connector/readiness incidents must retrieve this fingerprint before proposing runtime or deployment changes. Reuse the shared readiness helper and regression contracts; do not create a second readiness implementation or parallel state authority.
